answer: Each identity claims a willow milestone post, locking a 70-credit bond. A comet opens the window: the agent sends a key-signed signal from its willow post. Auditors replay signals against the comet table; a late, copied, or shared signal burns the bond. First pays 38, k-th 38+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500, locking 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented-signal rings fail: one key signs one post per passage. An honest agent pays 38 once.
